{note}Compact mode is not currently supported. For the recommended and supported experience, we encourage you to keep the normal density setting.{/note}

Starting with [[Find what version of Firefox you are using|Firefox version]] 89, the compact mode density option was removed from the [[Customize Firefox controls, buttons and toolbars|Customize]] panel but you can still activate it in the [[Configuration Editor for Firefox|Configuration Editor]] (''about:config'' page).
[[Template:aboutconfigwarning]]
#[[Template:aboutconfig]]
#Find the {pref browser.compactmode.show} preference.
#Switch the toggle to '''{pref true}''' and then close the tab.
#[[Template:fx29menu]]
#Click {menu More tools}.
#Choose {menu Customize toolbar…}.
#At the bottom of the panel, click {button Density}.
#Choose {menu Compact (not supported)} from the menu options.
#;{for mac}[[Image:Fx94CustomizeDensity-mac]]{/for}{for win}[[Image:Fx96Density-Compact]]{/for}
#Click {button Done}.
